sentences.en: Now that he has graduated, he must become more serious.
sentences.zh: 现在他毕业了，必须更加认真。

sentences.en: Two years have passed since Jim graduated from high school.
sentences.zh: 自从吉姆高中毕业后已经过去了两年。

sentences.en: The principal shook hands with each of the graduating pupils.
sentences.zh: 校长和每位毕业生都握了手。

senses.zh: 授予…学位；分等级；标上刻度
